name: Days AGO FatTree48 k48/h16 wall-clock timing on one GB200

00.description: Validate the SM100 build against Scalar, CPU and CUDA on one small fixture, then time the native 5,530-flow 30% load through 1.024 ms of virtual time and check its packet counts.

01.name: Days AGO FatTree48 10-second Nsight Systems compute triage
01.description: Capture the first 10 wall-clock seconds of the single-GB200 k48/h16 30% CUDA graph loop at 10 kHz with gb10x-ct. Stop collection at the first synchronized wave boundary at or after 10 s. Report Compute SOL, SM Issue Active and DRAM read/write bandwidth with graph nodes, encoded attempts and committed rounds. Require a native report at most 64 MiB. Continue through 1.024 ms of virtual time and compare the final fingerprint and work counters with an unprofiled run of the same binary.

02.name: Days AGO IKET graph initialization timing probe
02.description: On one GB200 use the pinned IKET 4.9.0.dev1 wheel and one binary with a single 32-thread CTA. In separate processes compare direct launch, a flat CUDA Graph instantiated before IKET startup, and the same graph instantiated after IKET startup. Require verified kernel output and one valid warp lifetime for the direct and early-start cases. The late-start case must either meet the same gate or reproduce the prior GraphManager abort before exporting a trace. Retain all case logs, available raw traces, and the CUDA and driver versions.
